tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant pyuria, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and growth of >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli. There is also microscopic hematuria and mild proteinuria. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts were detected. Clinical correlation and prompt treatment are recommended, especially considering the patient’s advanced age.
